title: GOE bulk universality for regular graphs with weak Anderson disorder

result.label: GOE bulk universality for regular graphs with weak Anderson disorder
result.statement: For every fixed degree d ≥ 3, the bulk adjacency-eigenvalue point process of a uniform simple random d -regular graph converges to the Gaussian orthogonal ensemble law, including for cubic graphs. The same fixed-energy universality persists under sufficiently weak fixed iid uniform diagonal disorder, throughout compact bands strictly inside the clean spectral edges.
